trades.name: LBAF of today's low (23436.75)

trades.name: Weakness below 6425
trades.quote: We may see some weakness if ES is holding below 6425, at least down to 6415.5-6418.25. I can’t say I’m particularly excited to take that kind of a short but one could consider joining a session downtrend on a lower high. It isn’t a setup worth rating to me but if there is some adverse news such as terrible earnings then maybe it is worth it on the chance sellers get through 6415.5 with traction.

trades.name: Hold of 6415.5-6418.25
trades.quote: If sellers can’t get back through 6415.5-6418.25 then we would have a bit of an inverse head and shoulders on the 30 and we know that is the spot key for buyers to see direct continuation higher this week. Today’s profile isn’t as clean as I would like to rate it an A+ but we have to consider it an A-/B+.

trades.name: LBAF of Thursday's low 6396.25, ideally 6393.75-6396.25
trades.quote: A LBAF of at least 96.25 but ideally the range targets 6415.5-6418.25 and has potential for today’s high and new highs. That is the trade I would want the most on ES and will rate it an A/A+
